about: The form (E.A.(P)-2) Indian missions use for police clearance certificates and other services on an Indian passport.
aliases: Application form for miscellaneous services on Indian passports
note: Labels read from the Embassy of India Monrovia copy of the form; the Abu Dhabi embassy copy may differ slightly. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

help.en: Your full name exactly as printed in your passport.
help.ar: اسمك الكامل كما هو مكتوب في جواز السفر.
help.ur: آپ کا پورا نام بالکل ویسا جیسا پاسپورٹ پر لکھا ہے۔

aliases: 2. Applicant's Car Driving License No. Date & Place of Issue

help.en: Your car driving licence number, with date and place of issue, if the service needs it.
help.ar: رقم رخصة القيادة وتاريخ ومكان إصدارها إن لزم.

help.ml: Your car driving licence number, with date and place of issue, if the service needs it.

help.en: Your address in India and where you live now, with phone numbers.

help.ur: Your address in India and where you live now, with phone numbers.

help.en: Your job and your work address, with phone and e-mail.

help.en: Say whether you are registered with the Indian mission or belong to an Indian organisation.

help.en: Your spouse's name and nationality, if married.

help.en: The date your passport expires, as printed in it.
help.ar: تاريخ انتهاء صلاحية جواز السفر كما هو مكتوب فيه.
help.ur: آپ کے پاسپورٹ کی میعاد ختم ہونے کی تاریخ، جیسی اس میں چھپی ہے۔
